about: Stage 4 of the Smoother streaming long-frame work, 2026-11-24 (lab 2, perf lock, owner stream-veil-1124). Arms: head = 0.1.0-alpha.22+streamaudit.1 (b2df865) at ~/snap/chromium/common/stream-audit-1123/butter; pv0 = head + veil as written (pv0.patch; run 2 only); pv = head + veil with the leak fix (pv.patch); pvh = pv + late hydration (pvh.patch). Per run: options, exit, verdicts, standard-window totals (Enter to 5 s after the stream completed), the completion frame and its parts (stream task = the replay timer task, rAF callback = ChatGPT 299268.*.js FrameRequestCallback), frames >= 200 ms, histogram, blocking per 10 s, forced and ChatGPT rAF-callback sums, the tail (TAIL_MS) totals and hydration, veil counts, samples (block counts and last-turn height over time), wheel-phase view shifts, the veil flicker probe, the API probe. Times in ms after Enter. No chat text.
